stratagem.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagem.lore: The combination of Tactical Dreadnought armour and transhuman physiology is redoubtable indeed.
stratagem.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagem.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagem.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagem.lore: Cumulative centuries of military experience help these veterans’ firepower hit home with murderous precision.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: ▪ [Lethal Hits]. ▪ [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagem.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagem.lore: Armoured gunships are often assigned to swoop in and relocate Terminator Squads in the midst of battle.
stratagem.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagem.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagem.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
